== Comic-Con 2001 photo identification ==
[[:File:Decipher staff Comic-Con 2001.jpg]] and its crops: the left-to-right identification (Sean Smallman, Jon Snyder, Kevin Reitzel, Kyle Heuer) is confirmed by the original 2001 caption, which reads "From L to R: Sean Smallman (Star Trek and small convention promotions), Jon Snyder (VP Fan Club Operations), Kevin Reitzel (Product Champion Coordinator), Kyle Heuer (Promotions Coordinator)" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20010805025951/http://www.theonering.net:80/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 preserved copy, 5 August 2001]). Bill Bisco's reading on 27 October 2026 agrees. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:12, 27 October 2026 (UTC)
